unit_contract.search_volume: Monthly searches reported by a keyword tool. null when unknown.
unit_contract.impressions_90d: This domain's own impressions over the measured GSC window (90 days). null when unknown.
unit_contract.demand_basis: Which field rank_score used: search_volume | impressions_90d | none.
unit_contract.removed_field: `volume` is removed. It previously held BOTH monthly search volume (semrush rows) and this domain's own 90d impressions (gsc rows), so rank_score compared incompatible units. A missing key throws; a wrong number does not.
unit_contract.never: Do not sum or compare across units. Volumes from disagreeing packets are recorded in volume_sources with volume_conflict=true and are never averaged.
unit_contract.precedent: Follows portfolio_demand.json (portfolio-demand-v1), which separated volume_mo from demand_signal/demand_signal_unit for this same defect.

fix_record_unclassified_2026-08-28.measured: These are the query phrasings that appear in data/report_fixes/html_report_contract.generated.json but carry NO incumbent-strength reading. The open-ground list is derived only from fix records whose fix_type reads the incumbent ("no/weak/medium/strong incumbent"), so these could never surface as an opportunity however good they were. Answer-engine citation occupancy was measured for every row in this set, which is the winnability reading they were missing.
fix_record_unclassified_2026-08-28.not_measured: search_volume, impressions_90d, keyword_difficulty and cpc_usd are unknown for every row and are carried as null. No page may print a volume figure for these queries. Incumbent STRENGTH is still not measured - occupancy answers "is a citation slot open", not "how strong is the incumbent" - and the two are different readings.
fix_record_unclassified_2026-08-28.derived_from: 1,159 fix records across 47 agent runs - the same corpus citation_shape_open_ground_2026-08-28 was derived from. That set took the fix records WITH an incumbent reading; this one takes the remainder.

dedupe_breakdown.engine_replicate_suffixes_collapsed: 25 fix records carried an answer-engine name inside the query field itself, e.g. "best TRT clinic near me (Perplexity)". Those are one query probed against three engines, not three queries. Stripping the suffix collapsed 25 rows to 9.
dedupe_breakdown.already_in_evidence_queries: 11 collapsed onto a phrasing already present in this file - 6 exactly, 5 as a wording variant. The 122 citation-shape rows landed the day before, so overlap was expected.
dedupe_breakdown.wording_variants_collapsed: 9 collapsed into another surviving row in this set.
dedupe_breakdown.not_a_query: 1 excluded: "Civil Surgeon Selection Criteria Chart" is an artifact title carried in the query field of a citation_readiness fix record, not a searched phrasing. Landing it as "real phrasing" would be false. "Form I-693 Red Flags Checklist" has the same defect but collapses onto an existing evidence row.

fix_record_unclassified_2026-08-28.collapse_rule: Per data/strategy/page_strategy_registry.json: a wording variation is not a distinct page intent. The clearest phrasing was kept and the absorbed phrasings are recorded on the surviving row under collapsed_from.
fix_record_unclassified_2026-08-28.network_page_status: 19 of these 47 already have an admitted route in this repo. They are still recorded here - evidence_queries.json records that a phrasing is real, not that it is unbuilt - but they are NOT written into data/demand/measured_demand.json, whose owner_seed_policy admits a T3 record only when "a measurement establishes the query is really asked and the network has no page for it". That condition was not weakened; those rows were left out of the demand file instead.
fix_record_unclassified_2026-08-28.row_order: Rows are stored in lead-intent priority order (T1 local/ready-to-buy, then T2 cost/in-market, then T3 selection/evaluating, then T4 informational). POSITIONAL ONLY, exactly as for citation_shape_open_ground_2026-08-28: rank_score is required to be null for demand_basis=none, so there is no ordering field to populate and none was invented. scripts/queries/ingest_gsc_evidence.py re-sorts this file on every successful GSC ingest, at which point the positional order is lost.

citation_shape_open_ground_2026-08-28.measured: Answer-engine citation shape: for each query the incumbent was measured absent or weak, AND no page anywhere in the network answers it.
citation_shape_open_ground_2026-08-28.not_measured: search_volume, impressions_90d, keyword_difficulty and cpc_usd are unknown for every row in this set and are carried as null. No page may print a volume figure for these queries.
citation_shape_open_ground_2026-08-28.collapse_rule: Per data/strategy/page_strategy_registry.json: a wording variation is not a distinct page intent. The clearest phrasing was kept and the absorbed phrasings are recorded on the surviving row under collapsed_from.
citation_shape_open_ground_2026-08-28.row_order: Rows are stored in lead-intent priority order (T1 local/ready-to-buy, then T2 cost/in-market, then T3 selection/evaluating, then T4 informational). This is POSITIONAL ONLY. No consumer of this file sorts on it, and no priority field was invented: rank_score is required to be null for rows with demand_basis=none, so there is no existing ordering field to populate. scripts/queries/ingest_gsc_evidence.py re-sorts this file on every successful GSC ingest, at which point the positional order is lost.
